integrity: The reported statements follow from stationary conservation equations with explicit one-sided flux asymptotics. Numerical finite-volume checks corroborate but are not substituted for infinite-limit proof. Previously published support bounds and general master equations are cited as prior work; no independent review or priority certification is represented.
limitations: Exactly two ordered particles, no translational thermal noise, positive harmonic/repulsive/propulsion/switching parameters. Endpoint amplitude constants established positive and finite but not evaluated in closed form. No assertion for N>2 or arbitrary switching laws. Publication priority is qualified by earlier general stationary equations and possible broader piecewise-deterministic edge theorems.
title: Two unequal stationary gap edges in a two-particle active Dyson gas
